rows.name: Human aorta (cardiac output)
rows.citation: Vincent J.-L. (2008) Understanding cardiac output. Critical Care 12, 174
rows.notes: About 5 L/min at rest (4-8 L/min); aorta about 2.5 cm across

rows.name: Amazon River
rows.citation: Dai A. & Trenberth K.E. (2002) Estimates of freshwater discharge from continents: latitudinal and seasonal variations. J Hydrometeorol 3, 660
rows.notes: 6642 km3 per year; channel width at Obidos about 2 km (approximate)

rows.name: Florida Current (Gulf Stream)
rows.citation: Meinen C.S., Baringer M.O. & Garcia R.F. (2010) Florida Current transport variability: an analysis of annual and longer-period signals. Deep-Sea Res I 57, 835
rows.notes: About 32 Sv through the Florida Straits (about 80 km wide)

rows.name: Antarctic Circumpolar Current
rows.citation: Donohue K.A. et al. (2016) Mean Antarctic Circumpolar Current transport measured in Drake Passage. GRL 43, 11760
rows.notes: 173.3 Sv through Drake Passage (about 800 km wide): the largest current on Earth

rows.notes: 1308 km3 per year at the mouth; width at Kinshasa approximate

rows.citation: Dai A. & Trenberth K.E. (2002) Estimates of freshwater discharge from continents: latitudinal and seasonal variations. J Hydrometeorol 3, 660
rows.notes: 610 km3 per year at the mouth; width at Vicksburg approximate

rows.name: Danube River
rows.citation: Dai A. & Trenberth K.E. (2002) Estimates of freshwater discharge from continents: latitudinal and seasonal variations. J Hydrometeorol 3, 660

rows.citation: McCarthy G.D. et al. (2015) Measuring the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation at 26 N. Prog Oceanogr 130, 91
